> Originally published on [producthunt.com](https://www.producthunt.com/p/tabstack/launchmaxxing-tabstack-on-product-hunt)

Mozilla-backed Tabstack is launching today on Product Hunt. 

This is their 7th launch there. 

I had the opportunity to collaborate with Tessa Kriesel and team and wanted to reflect on how we're leveraging Product Hunt as a growth channel.

---

> _**We want to drive as much growth as possible.**_

Kriesel is the GOAT in the DevTools space. So, when she reached out to collaborate, it was a no brainer for me - and also, an inspiring challenge.

Tabstack is a web API for people and teams running their own models. It fits in a competitive product category, browser automation tools, with multiple, established alternatives.

How to differentiate and drive developer awareness? Product Hunt.

Product Hunt is an awesome place for developer tools to launch, a place where most users are technical founders, a place where developer-first products like Supabase, Kilo and Mastra, are among the most followed and loved products. 

From my perspective, there's a blue ocean opportunity for any dev-first company ready to take it seriously. So, we jumped in and explored the opportunities to fully leverage Product Hunt as a growth channel.

## Launches as a growth channel

I've launched 42+ developer tools on Product Hunt in the last 4 years - or maybe 500? To be honest, I've lost count, and above all, the #1 lesson learned: Product Hunt isn't a one-time opportunity.

The best developer tools launch multiple times. Take Supabase (16 launches), Kilo (6) and Mastra (4).

Product Hunt is about consistency. 

We applied it to Tabstack. We kept things simple, and just launched. Multiple times.

Some launches ranked among the Top Products of the Day, some didn't, some even didn't get featured. 

We kept launching, and it pays off in the long run.

Each launch reaches more people. Each launch builds more followers, and this helps future launches.

Launching multiple times on Product Hunt creates a tailwind.

Results? More people follow Tabstack, more AI answers mention it. The product is among the best browser automation tools, according to Product Hunt.

Kriesel sums it up perfectly.

> _**Product Hunt is a two-pronged goal for Tabstack: drive developer awareness and train the LLMs. We accomplished both.**_

## One more thing

Product Hunt isn't just a launch pad, it's also an ad platform. The team ran multiple campaigns, experimenting with multiple formats, to A/B test taglines and keep the momentum.

That's it! That's how Tabstack is leveraging Product Hunt as a growth channel. 

They're launching again today.
